title: LangGraph overview
content: LangGraph is a framework for building stateful, multi-actor applications with language models. Graph nodes read and update shared state. Conditional edges can route execution based on evidence quality, and explicit recursion limits prevent unbounded execution.

title: Evidence-based research agents
content: Reliable research agents retain source identifiers alongside extracted passages. Reports should cite those identifiers, while a separate verification step checks whether the cited passage supports each factual claim. Source diversity reduces dependence on a single publisher.

title: Secure server-side web fetching
content: Server-side fetchers should allow only HTTP and HTTPS, resolve host names, reject private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses, limit response size, set timeouts, and treat individual fetch failures as non-fatal.

title: Structured model outputs
content: Schema-constrained model output makes agent transitions more reliable. Validation failures can be handled by one bounded repair attempt. Token counts and model-call counts should be recorded for operational visibility.

title: Research workflow evaluation
content: Evidence sufficiency can be assessed per research question using relevance, number of independent sources, and uncovered information. A bounded second search round may target only the identified gaps before report generation.
